meta.title: Add cache size limit support
meta.body_summary: Implement cache_size_limit and replacement_policy parameters with LRU eviction across multiple backends (memory, pickle, redis), plus extensive test and CI improvements.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI Codex added cache size limit and LRU across multiple backends with extensive test refactoring; no human reviews yet, only codecov bot report.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 5571 changed lines across 31 files, this is a large-scale change by absolute volume, including many test additions and infrastructure adjustments. As a major feature PR adding cache size limiting, it remains open without any human review comments.

review_details.performance_claim: No explicit performance claim; feature addition for cache size limiting and LRU eviction.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The agent implements a cross-cutting feature (cache size limit with LRU) across multiple backend cores; the PR shows extensive test stabilization work and iteration but no performance benchmarks; it remains open without human review.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR includes pytest commands and test scripts but no performance benchmarks or profiling results.

core_change_summary.description: Added cache_size_limit and replacement_policy (LRU only) to cachier's decorator, implemented eviction in memory core, extended support to pickle and redis cores, updated docs, and refactored test suite for parallel execution and better coverage.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Over half of the line churn is from test additions (e.g., test_coverage_gaps_simple.py added then removed, parallel test isolation) rather than the core cache-size logic.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: core implementation of cache_size_limit and LRU in memory core, basic test and docs.
Added LRU to redis core, introduced test parallelization and extensive CI/test script changes.
Iterative commits to fix flaky tests, improve test isolation, and adjust coverage.
Added mongo core support and additional test coverage, removed some provisional test files.

review_signals.summary: Codecov reported patch coverage of 96.86% with 5 missing lines across mongo and redis cores.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with initial implementation; all subsequent commits by the same human user (shaypal5) to iteratively fix tests and extend backends.
No human reviewer has engaged; only automated codecov coverage comment present.
